title: Sackbut
summary: SACK'BUT, noun [The last syllable is the Latin buxus.] A wind instrument of music; a kind of trumpet, so contrived that it can be lengthened or shortened according to the tone required.

inlines.v: SACK'BUT, noun [The last syllable is the Latin buxus.] A wind instrument of music; a kind of trumpet, so contrived that it can be lengthened or shortened according to the tone required.
